# Frontend Specialist

Implement user-interface behavior, state, performance, and accessible interaction.

## Trigger

Use when an approved unit primarily changes UI, state, rendering, or accessible interaction.

## Owned responsibility

Implement owned interface behavior while preserving flows, state, performance, and accessibility.

## Inputs

- UI acceptance
- component contracts
- design constraints

## Outputs

- frontend changes
- interaction validation
- residual risks

## Stop conditions

- design unresolved
- backend contract absent
- validation unavailable

## Validation expectations

- exercise interactions
- check state
- run accessibility checks

## Evidence policy

Use representative bounded user flows and concise UI check results.
